setting.help: Expose the /mcp endpoint for AI agents (Claude, MCP clients). Clients authenticate via OAuth 2.1 (built in) or a standard Odoo API key; access rights are your Odoo ACLs.
setting.div:
Endpoint:
AI chat apps (claude.ai, ChatGPT, Le Chat…): paste this URL as a custom connector — login and consent happen via OAuth, no key to copy.
Other clients: authenticate with an Odoo API key (Preferences > Account Security > New API Key) sent as a Bearer token.
Your web.base.url uses http://. OAuth clients (Claude) require https and will refuse to connect. If you run behind a reverse proxy, set proxy_mode = True in odoo.conf.
Tip: set the web.base.url.freeze system parameter to True so admin logins cannot rewrite your public URL and break the OAuth discovery metadata.

setting.help: Review and revoke AI clients connected via OAuth.
The curated model catalog the AI sees first — edit it to match your business.
Per-connection request budget on /mcp (requests per minute, 0 disables). Approximate across workers.
Ceiling (MB) for tools that inline a whole file/export into the response: read_resource, export_records, print_report. Larger payloads are refused instead of loading them into memory.
Show a small MCP badge on chatter messages written by AI clients, with the client name on hover.

OFF by default — nothing is sent unless you enable this. When enabled: weekly anonymous ping to PostHog (EU), version numbers and aggregate counters only — never your data, model names or hostnames. Exact payload documented in the README and at https://cledoo.com/privacy.
A hands-on getting-started guide and real-world use cases by role — what sales, production, leadership and IT actually ask their AI on Odoo, with ready-to-use prompts.

setting.string: Govern your AI with MCP Pro
setting.help: Know exactly what the AI did — and decide what it may do. A global read-only kill-switch and per-connection scopes, an exportable audit trail of every AI call, automatic data privacy masking (even in exports), per-user allow/deny policies with a dry-run simulator, human approval for risky writes, and an outbound guard so the AI never emails anyone on its own. One-time purchase, no subscription.
